description: This file defines a generic interface 'IAppLogger<T>' in the namespace 'Microsoft.eShopWeb.ApplicationCore.Interfaces'. It abstracts logging functionalities, providing methods for logging information and warnings, thereby decoupling the application code from specific logging implementations.

classes.name: IAppLogger<T>
classes.description: A generic logging interface providing methods to log informational messages and warnings, designed to abstract away direct dependencies on ASP.NET Core logging types.

methods.name: LogInformation
methods.description: Logs an informational message with optional formatting arguments.

methods.name: LogWarning
methods.description: Logs a warning message with optional formatting arguments.
